thread:
leah_people_ops: Heads-up: mid-cycle reviewers — proposing a sampling + staggered-deadline plan to even out review load and surface calibration signals earlier. Need quick sign-off so we can push reminders this week.

maria_manager_rye: Love the idea. Quick Q — how are you defining the sampling strata? will managers still get a contiguous batch to review?

dan_platform_eng: Also want to know if this affects the manager handback SLA (currently 5 business days).

leah_people_ops: Great questions — summary of the plan below. TL;DR: keep manager handback SLA but stagger submission windows for reviewers, plus sample high-impact folks earlier for calibration.

Plan (concise):
1) Sampling strata: early-signal batch (20%), baseline batch (50%), cross-team/edge cases (30%). Early-signal = ICs with customer-facing metrics or recent launch work.
2) Staggered reviewer deadlines: assign 60% of each reviewer's queue due by Day 3, remaining 40% due by Day 7 (gives managers time to escalate heavy items).
3) Calibration checkpoints: two 90-min sessions — "Signal Check" on Day 4 and "Consensus & Escalation" on Day 8.
4) Spot-checking: ops team will surface 10 random reviews per manager for quality checks pre-calibration.

Example CSV mapping (for ops automation):
```
reviewer,assigned_count,early_signal_count,day3_due,day7_due,overflow_contact
toni_engineering_manager,20,4,12,8,@leah_people_ops
maria_manager_rye,18,3,11,7,@leah_people_ops
dan_platform_eng,15,3,9,6,@simon_recruiter
```

leah_people_ops: Notes:
- We won't change the manager handback SLA (5 business days) — the stagger is for reviewer side only.
- Ops-bot will send automated reminders at Day 2, Day 6 and on final day.
- If a manager wants all reviews earlier, they can opt in; we'll mark their team as "accelerated" in the spreadsheet.

toni_engineering_manager: That stagger looks good. Can we reserve 1 calibration slot for folks in APAC timezone? otherwise it's hard for some managers to join.

leah_people_ops: Yes — plan to run the Signal Check twice: 08:00 PST and 18:00 PST (covers APAC). I'll post slots in the calendar.

simon_recruiter: Heads-up — we have a hiring surge in mid-June, several new hires will need onboarding and reviews added to manager queues. We'll send a list of start dates so ops can factor that into reviewer assignments.

leah_people_ops: Perfect — please DM the start-date CSV to me and I'll exclude brand-new hires from early-signal sampling (gives managers time to get context).

ops-bot: Reminder set: automated reviewer reminders: Day 2 (72hr), Day 6 (48hr remaining), Day 9 (final). Calendar invites scheduled after sign-off.

dan_platform_eng: Sounds good to me. :thumbsup:

leah_people_ops: Thanks all — if no objections by EOD today I'll lock the plan and post the opt-in form for accelerated teams. :white_check_mark:
